items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But now when I was with Ben, he brought in Eddie Nicholson from Tulsa

ctx.x: They put everybody down who was playing that -- who was playing the other way, Yeah, playing the other way. That's when Ben stopped doing that, because Ben was using -- used to always use a buzz until that, and he

just eased on out of it. But now when I was with Ben, he brought in Eddie Nicholson from Tulsa and -- who plays a straight, swinging drum, you know, and we had one of the best rhythm sections down on 52nd Street.
